bounds.profile_moments: finite list determined by selected symbol and boundary heat coefficients through dimension four

routes.locality_engine: covariant higher derivatives plus matched local Pauli-Villars moment equations

claim_boundary: This LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC/EUCLIDEAN-SPECTRAL preflight gives a conditional strictly four-dimensional covariant-regulator receiver for a selected fourth-order BV Hessian satisfying explicit ellipticity, BRST, pairing, projector, boundary and contour hypotheses. It derives the regulated canonical-map Jacobian and the Weyl/Duhamel Ward symbol, but it does not prove that Candidate A or B supplies such a Hessian. It does not construct an actual regulator, compute determinant or anomaly coefficients, identify the four-dimensional and DR/MS schemes, establish QAP or an all-loop/Lorentzian QME, or make state, particle, scattering or unitarity claims.

required_components: full minimal nonminimal and regulator-field row ordering
primal dual domains and zero-mode projectors
first_missing_action_dependent_datum.why_atoms_and_pairing_do_not_determine_i: the BV atom/pairing ledger fixes the cotangent geometry but not the action Hessian, gauge fixing, reducibility tower, elliptic domain, spectrum or thimbles

next_gate: Select Candidate A or B and import its complete gauge-fixed Euclidean Hessian symbol complex, domains, zero modes and contours; then solve one declared regulator route and evaluate the Ward receiver.

regulated_canonical_map.inverse: log Ber_R(inverse)=+40 Tr[Pi_perp tau F(K/Lambda^4) Pi_perp]
regulated_canonical_map.jacobian: log Ber_R=-40 Tr[Pi_perp tau F(K/Lambda^4) Pi_perp]
regulated_canonical_map.local_bulk_asymptotic: Tr[tau F(K/Lambda^4)] has local fourth-order heat coefficients
regulated_canonical_map.zero_mode_term: -40 Tr[Pi_0 tau] remains finite-rank and generally global

scheme_comparison.common_fact: both require an action-specific mixing/subtraction map
scheme_comparison.dr_ms_route: Euler and other d-dimensional continuations form an evanescent torsor before projection
scheme_comparison.forbidden_identification: no four-dimensional finite counterterm coordinate is identified with a DR/MS evanescent continuation coordinate
scheme_comparison.four_dimensional_route: local finite counterterms are parameterized directly in the certified four-dimensional H04 module

scope.variables: dressed metric plus algebraic Weyl quartet

required: scalar-parent K and BRST symbol complex
three-form reducibility tower K and BRST symbol complex
harmonic-form zero modes and boundary policies

selected_hessian_hypotheses.PV_fields: finite BRST doublets with pairing-compatible mass matrices and statistics satisfying every selected heat-moment equation
selected_hessian_hypotheses.boundary: local elliptic boundary problem invariant under Q and sharp
selected_hessian_hypotheses.contours: all indefinite bosonic multipliers and PV fields carry declared thimbles compatible with sharp
selected_hessian_hypotheses.operator: even gauge-fixed fourth-order differential operator K on the full graded BV bundle
selected_hessian_hypotheses.pairing: K^sharp=K on the declared primal/dual domains
selected_hessian_hypotheses.principal_symbol: elliptic and sectorial on the declared real/complex contours
selected_hessian_hypotheses.projectors: Pi_0, Pi_perp commute with Q and are dual-compatible

ward_symbol.Diff_bulk: trace of a covariant commutator, zero modulo the declared boundary-domain contribution
ward_symbol.Duhamel_failure_term: 40 Tr[Pi_perp tau integral_0^1 F'_Duhamel(K,QK;u) du Pi_perp]
ward_symbol.Weyl_if_K_invariant: Q_W log Ber_R=-40 Tr[Pi_perp omega F(K/Lambda^4) Pi_perp]
ward_symbol.local_breaking_receiver: heat coefficients through engineering dimension four, projected to the certified dressed H04/H14 module
